description: Audit any local business's online presence in one run: Google Business Profile data (rating, review count, category, contact), recent reviews with urgency classification and owner-response detection, website AI-readiness scan (llms.txt, JSON-LD, robots.txt AI-crawler rules), a transparent presence score /100, and ready-to-use deliverables (publishable llms.txt, LocalBusiness JSON-LD, AI-drafted review responses, prioritized action plan). Use when you need to audit a local business before selling it marketing services, or to check whether ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini can 'see' a business. Pricing: $1.00 per run + $0.50 per business audited.

dryRun.description: When true, the actor runs fully but skips all pay-per-event charges. Use it for testing and integration QA.
dryRun.title: Dry run (no billing events)

language.description: Google Maps interface language code (fr, en, de...). Affects localized labels parsing.
language.title: Interface language

maxReviews.description: Number of most recent Google reviews to scrape and classify (urgency detection, owner-response check). Between 1 and 30.
maxReviews.title: Max reviews to analyze

proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy settings. Residential proxies are strongly recommended — Google Maps blocks datacenter IPs. Defaults to RESIDENTIAL.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

query.description: Business name + city used to find its Google Maps profile (e.g. 'Boulangerie Paul Mersch' or 'restaurant Esch-sur-Alzette'). The first, most relevant place is audited. Optional if websiteUrl alone is enough for you.
query.title: Business search query

websiteUrl.description: Full URL of the business website (e.g. https://example.lu). Scanned without a browser for AI-readiness: JSON-LD structured data, LocalBusiness schema, meta description, H1, Open Graph, /llms.txt, and robots.txt rules for AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, CCBot).
websiteUrl.title: Business website URL

name: local_presence_audit
